description: Reads a record back from an HTTP JSON API by the action's correlation token, and compares its fields with the intended values.

connection.name: service_reader
connection.description: Base URL of the service API, used only to read records, for example https://api.example.com.

needs: A --set path=TEMPLATE such as /tickets/{token} or /orders?reference={token}, an --in expect=REFERENCE to a record of the intended field values, and optionally HTTP_OBSERVER_TOKEN for a read-only bearer token.

inputs.description: A record of field paths and intended values, for example a step output written before the action. The observer never sees the action's own receipt.

effect.intent: The service stores the record with the intended values.

setup: In runtime.json, set environment.service_reader to the API base URL. For a bearer token, add a runtime profile with env ["HTTP_OBSERVER_TOKEN"] and set observe.runtime to it. The action must send METHOD_OPERATION_ID where the service stores a reference (an idempotency key, an external ID, or a note field), and the path template must find the record by {token}.
